title: Palladium ancient weapon (hardware)
description:
Catalog row for **ancient / medieval / improvised melee and missile hardware** (Nightbane RPG Weapons & Equipment tables pp. 204–209 and equivalents in other Palladium lines). Distinct from **`palladium-weapon-proficiency.schema.json`** (W.P. skill ladders).

**Genre-specific stats:** Printings disagree on damage and sometimes cost/length (e.g. Short Sword **1D6** in Nightbane vs **2D4** in Palladium Fantasy). Put shared identity on the root; put every measurable table column that can differ by line under **`genreStats[]`**, one object per **`gameSystem`**. Engines resolve the active host/creation genre to pick the matching **`genreStats`** row.

**Cost / currency:** Each genre block’s **`averageCost`** (or a **`qualityVariants[]`** entry’s cost) requires **`currency`** + **`min`** (optional **`max`** for ranges). Use open currency slugs (`usd` for modern $-priced lines, `gold` for Fantasy, `credits` for Rifts, …). Optional **`unit`**: each / dozen / score / **pair** / other.

**Damage authoring:** Prefer machine-friendly **`damage`** dice tokens (`1D6`, `2D6`, `1D8+2`). Optional **`damageBookDisplay`** preserves the printed range form (`2-12`, `1-8+2`) when useful for tooltips. When the book lists quality tiers, put them in **`qualityVariants[]`** (each with its own damage/cost) and omit a single root **`damage`**. When damage is not numeric (e.g. blow-gun darts), omit **`damage`** and use **`damageSpecial`** / **`payloadNotes`**.

**Oriental listings** (Nightbane pp. 206–207): use **`category`: `oriental`**. One catalog row per named weapon (split compound headings). Structured flags: **`canEntangle`**, **`objectSdc`**, **`requiresHandToHand`**.

**Miscellaneous tools** (blackjack, frying pan, etc.): set **`weaponProficiencyEligible`: false** — the Nightbane table states they gain **no W.P. bonuses**.

$schema.description: Optional editor pointer to this schema `$id`.

name.description: Printed weapon name (e.g. Short Sword, Katana).

aliases.description: Alternate book names or spellings for search (optional).

description.description: Optional prose notes (usage, rarity, GM guidance).

category.description: Table section from the ancient weapons listing.

entryRole.description: **weapon** (default); **ammunition** for Arrows / Bolts rows; **improvised** for household/tool rows under Miscellaneous; **weapon_set** for paired/set SKUs (e.g. Daisho) that reference component weapons.

gameSystems.description: Game lines this hardware appears in. Each listed slug **MUST** have a matching **`genreStats[].gameSystem`** entry.

sources.description: Book + page refs per game line (same shape as skills / W.P.).

weaponProficiencyEligible.description: When **false**, W.P. strike/parry/etc. do **not** apply (Nightbane Miscellaneous table note). When **true**, link via **`linkedWpSkillId`** when known.

linkedWpSkillId.description: Optional catalog W.P. id (e.g. `wp_sword`, `wp_battle_axe`, `wp_polearm`). Omit when **`weaponProficiencyEligible`** is false or the mapping is unresolved.

throwable.description: True when the book treats this as a thrown weapon (throwing axe, javelin, dagger, etc.). Distinct from missile bows.

canEntangle.description: True when the book states the weapon can entangle (nunchaku, kusari-gama, jitte/sai, manriki-gusari, etc.).

objectSdc.description: Printed object S.D.C. for the hardware itself when given (e.g. Shikomi-Zue staff S.D.C. 50).

requiresHandToHand.description: When set, only characters with one of these Hand-to-Hand style ids may use the weapon (e.g. Kusari-Gama / Kyoketsu-Shogi require martial arts or assassin). Empty/omitted = no H.T.H. gate.

componentWeaponIds.description: For **`entryRole`: `weapon_set`** — catalog ids of the component weapons (e.g. Daisho → katana + wakizashi).

genreStats.description: Per-genre table columns. One entry per **`gameSystems`** slug. Fields omitted on a block are **not** inherited from another genre — author the full measurable set for each line (or omit only when that line’s printing lacks the column).

weaponCategory.description: Matches Nightbane RPG ancient weapons table section headings (pp. 204–205) plus **oriental** for the Ancient Oriental Weapons prose list (pp. 206–207).

pageNumber.description: Printed page where this weapon’s table row begins.

damageNotation.description: Machine-friendly damage token. Compact **`NdM±k`** (e.g. `1D6`, `2D6`, `1D8+2`) preferred. Legacy free-form allowed when the book cannot be reduced to a single token.

oneOf.description: Canonical: `1D6`, `2d4`, `1D8+2`, or a plain integer string (including `0`).
Prose / multi-clause damage that does not fit the canonical token.

lengthMeasure.description: Average length from the table. Prefer numeric meters/feet when a single value; use min/max when the book prints a range (e.g. Short Spear 1.2–1.8 m / 4–6 ft). **`display`** preserves the printed cell.

weightMeasure.description: Average weight from the table. Prefer **`kg`** / **`lb`**; use min/max for ranges. **`display`** preserves the printed cell.

costMeasure.description: Average cost for one genre (or one quality tier). **`currency`** is always required on the block. Use open slugs: **`usd`**, **`gold`**, **`credits`**, …. Exact price: set **`min`** only. Printed ranges: set both **`min`** and **`max`**. Optional **`unit`** for ammo packs or paired sets.

currency.description: Currency slug for this genre (e.g. `usd`, `gold`, `credits`, `silver`). Open vocabulary — prefer stable lowercase slugs.

min.description: Price, or the low end of a printed range.

max.description: High end when the book prints a cost range. Omit for a single price.

unit.description: Pricing unit — default **each** for weapons; **dozen** / **score** for arrows/bolts; **pair** for paired-weapon SKUs (e.g. Jitte/Sai $50/pair).

rangeMeasure.description: Missile / thrown effective range when the table lists one (e.g. Crossbow 500–700 ft).

qualityVariant.description: One printed quality tier (e.g. Katana regular vs top/authentic). Each tier carries its own damage and usually its own cost.

id.description: Stable tier slug within the weapon (e.g. `regular`, `top`, `fair`, `high`).

genreStatBlock.description: One genre’s hardware columns. Provide **`damage`**, and/or **`qualityVariants`**, and/or **`damageSpecial`** / **`payloadNotes`** so the weapon has an authored damage story.

gameSystem.description: Must appear in the root **`gameSystems`** array.

damage.description: Primary damage for this genre when the book lists a single value. Omit when using **`qualityVariants`** only, or when damage is non-numeric (**`damageSpecial`** / **`payloadNotes`**).

damageBookDisplay.description: Optional verbatim printed damage cell (e.g. `2-12`, `1-8 + 2`) for UI that mirrors the book.

damageSpecial.description: Non-numeric or special damage story (e.g. `Dart itself does no damage`). Use instead of or alongside omitting **`damage`**.

payloadNotes.description: Poison, drug, or other payload guidance when the weapon’s effect is not intrinsic dice damage (blow-gun darts, etc.).

qualityVariants.description: Quality tiers from the book (Katana, Wakizashi, Aikuchi/Tanto cost bands, etc.). When present, each variant owns damage/cost; omit a single root **`damage`** / **`averageCost`** unless a non-tier default is also printed.

range.description: Missile/thrown range when listed for this genre.

notes.description: Genre-specific caveats (ammo packaging, rate of fire prose, dual-mode use, etc.).
